title: Service Mesh Traffic Policy Structure
description: Structural documentation for common traffic policy primitives used across service mesh implementations

sections.name: Traffic Split
sections.description: Canary and blue-green deployment configuration dividing traffic between service versions

fields.name: service
fields.description: The apex service name that receives all inbound traffic

fields.name: backends
fields.description: Weighted list of backend services. Weights must sum to 100.

sections.name: Circuit Breaker (Outlier Detection)
sections.description: Configuration for ejecting unhealthy endpoints from the load balancing pool

fields.name: consecutive5xxErrors
fields.description: Number of consecutive 5xx responses before ejecting an endpoint

fields.name: baseEjectionTime
fields.description: Minimum ejection duration. Ejected endpoints stay out at least this long.

fields.name: maxEjectionPercent
fields.description: Maximum percentage of endpoints that can be ejected simultaneously

sections.name: Retry Policy
sections.description: Automatic retry configuration for failed requests

fields.name: retryOn
fields.description: Comma-separated conditions that trigger a retry

sections.name: Mutual TLS
sections.description: Peer authentication and certificate management for service-to-service traffic

fields.name: mode
fields.description: STRICT: mutual TLS required. PERMISSIVE: both plaintext and mTLS accepted. DISABLE: no TLS.

fields.name: portLevelMtls
fields.description: Port-specific mTLS overrides. Key is port number as string.

sections.name: Authorization Policy
sections.description: Fine-grained access control for service-to-service communication

fields.name: action
fields.description: Action taken when the policy matches

fields.name: rules
fields.description: Match rules. A request is allowed if it matches any rule.

fields.name: from
fields.description: Source principal selectors (namespace, service account, IP)

fields.name: to
fields.description: Target operation selectors (host, method, path, port)
